stock.description: Yoho Group Holdings Ltd. operates a retail business with both online and physical store presences, serving customers in Hong Kong, mainland China, and other international markets. The company provides a wide array of products, such as consumer electronics, health and beauty technology items, home appliances, computer hardware and accessories, and general lifestyle goods, which are sold via its e-commerce platform and retail outlets. Founded in 2013, the firm's main office is located in Kwun Tong, Hong Kong.
